//! @generated — modul `penggambar`. Backend adalah implementasi, bukan struktur
//! program: `caller` dan `app` tidak berubah saat backend diganti.

#[cfg(feature = "cpu")]
pub mod cpu;
pub mod font;
pub mod pixels;
pub mod png;
#[cfg(feature = "gpu")]
pub mod gpu;
#[cfg(feature = "skia")]
pub mod skia;

use crate::core::{Align, Color, Frame, Point, Rect, Size};
use std::fmt;

/// Backend dipilih saat runtime lewat `--backend cpu|skia|gpu`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Backend {
    Cpu,
    Skia,
    Gpu,
}

impl Backend {
    pub fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, RenderError> {
        match value.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
            "cpu" | "software" | "soft" => Ok(Self::Cpu),
            "skia" => Ok(Self::Skia),
            "gpu" | "wgpu" => Ok(Self::Gpu),
            other => Err(RenderError::Message(format!(
                "unknown backend '{other}' (expected cpu, skia or gpu)"
            ))),
        }
    }

    /// Baca `--backend` dari argumen; jika tidak ada, pakai default hasil export.
    pub fn from_args_or_default(default: &str) -> Result<Self, RenderError> {
        let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
        let mut selected = default.to_string();
        while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
            if arg == "--backend" {
                selected = args
                    .next()
                    .ok_or_else(|| RenderError::Message("--backend needs a value".into()))?;
            }
        }
        Self::parse(&selected)
    }

    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Cpu => "cpu",
            Self::Skia => "skia",
            Self::Gpu => "gpu",
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for Backend {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(self.as_str())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum DrawCmd {
    Rect {
        rect: Rect,
        fill: Color,
        radius: f32,
        opacity: f32,
    },
    StrokeRect {
        rect: Rect,
        stroke: Color,
        width: f32,
        radius: f32,
    },
    Ellipse {
        rect: Rect,
        fill: Color,
        opacity: f32,
    },
    Line {
        from: Point,
        to: Point,
        stroke: Color,
        width: f32,
    },
    Text {
        rect: Rect,
        text: String,
        size: f32,
        color: Color,
        bold: bool,
        align: Align,
    },
    Image {
        rect: Rect,
        bytes: Vec<u8>,
    },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct DrawList {
    pub commands: Vec<DrawCmd>,
}

impl DrawList {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, command: DrawCmd) {
        self.commands.push(command);
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum RenderError {
    BackendDisabled(&'static str),
    Message(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for RenderError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::BackendDisabled(name) => write!(
                f,
                "backend '{name}' was not compiled in; rebuild with --features {name}"
            ),
            Self::Message(message) => f.write_str(message),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for RenderError {}

pub trait Renderer {
    fn kind(&self) -> Backend;
    fn render(&mut self, list: &DrawList, size: Size) -> Result<Frame, RenderError>;
}

#[cfg(feature = "cpu")]
fn make_cpu() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Ok(Box::new(cpu::CpuRenderer::new()))
}

#[cfg(not(feature = "cpu"))]
fn make_cpu() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Err(RenderError::BackendDisabled("cpu"))
}

#[cfg(feature = "skia")]
fn make_skia() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Ok(Box::new(skia::SkiaRenderer::new()))
}

#[cfg(not(feature = "skia"))]
fn make_skia() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Err(RenderError::BackendDisabled("skia"))
}

#[cfg(feature = "gpu")]
fn make_gpu() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Ok(Box::new(gpu::GpuRenderer::new()))
}

#[cfg(not(feature = "gpu"))]
fn make_gpu() -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    Err(RenderError::BackendDisabled("gpu"))
}

pub fn create(backend: Backend) -> Result<Box<dyn Renderer>, RenderError> {
    match backend {
        Backend::Cpu => make_cpu(),
        Backend::Skia => make_skia(),
        Backend::Gpu => make_gpu(),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn backend_parsing() {
        assert_eq!(Backend::parse("CPU"), Ok(Backend::Cpu));
        assert_eq!(Backend::parse("wgpu"), Ok(Backend::Gpu));
        assert!(Backend::parse("nope").is_err());
    }
}
